prompt: In the vastness of the universe, a huge space station surrounds a giant glowing book. The metal shell of the station reflects the light emanating from the book, and mysterious symbols and galactic patterns glitter on the pages of the book. The astronauts, dressed in advanced space suits, are relaxing in zero gravity, flipping through the cosmic encyclopedia in their hands, their silhouettes standing out in the light of the book. The surrounding nebulae are like flowing paint, forming a gorgeous background, and the colors of the nebulae blend into the pattern of the book, as if the book and the universe are one. At the bottom of the picture, The whole poster is presented in a hard sci-fi light and shadow effect, showing the connection between the mystery of the universe and reading to explore the unknown. --ar 3:4 --v 7
